description: Use when the user wants to play a finished game again with exactly the same questions. Pass replayEditionId from list_quizzes. Creates a new lobby with a fresh invitation; a rematch cannot be edited (use create_quiz with the old rounds for an edited version). Never starts play. Reuse requestId for identical retries.

nickname.description: Host player name. Use Host when no name was supplied.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this intent. Reuse it with identical arguments after a lost response; use a new UUID for a different action.

name: replay_game
title: Set up a rematch
